evidence: Plan-controlled in-run page prerequisite. The current Batch 5 FA-20 scaffold (21 A items) was read at statement-and-strategy level: it supplies the PVM definition, the bounded Borel PVM integral as a star homomorphism, the bounded spectral theorem with uniqueness, and Stone's resolvent formula. This page consumes exactly the PVM calculus and uniqueness interfaces and constructs the unbounded integral itself; the supplier is planned in-run content, not publication.
